claims.claim: Acosta had set December 7 at 5 p.m. as the end of a temporary pause on victim notification.
On December 6 the FBI lead agent reported that many original victim/witness letters were still being held.
On December 7 Sanchez asked Sloman to hold off on sending victim-notification letters pending further discussion of content.
Villafana asked at 17:05:56 to send the letter; Sloman replied at 17:08:19 EST, 'Hold the letter.'
Sloman later said the hold was the product of speaking to 'somebody' but could not be definitive as to whom.
The available record does not establish a secret Main Justice order, corrupt motive, or intelligence role in the hold.
